packet-00.record: On 18 November 2024, draft S/2024/826, submitted by Sierra Leone and the United Kingdom, received 14 votes in favour, one against and no abstentions. Russia cast the sole negative vote and China voted in favour. The permanent-member negative vote blocked adoption [VOTE]. The draft proposed ending hostilities, protecting civilians and facilitating humanitarian access. It created no Council mandate [TEXT, VOTE]. Analytical suggestion: distinguish possible amendments from action under existing mandates.

Russia cast the sole negative vote and China voted in favour. The permanent-member negative vote blocked adoption [VOTE].
